facets.description: RuleActionsButtons.V2 passes the now-optional `rule` prop to `useRulerRuleAbility`, but that hook's parameter is still a required `RulerRuleDTO`. Only the plural `useRulerRuleAbilities` was widened to accept undefined.
`getEditableIdentifier` can return undefined, so the whole actions block (Edit button and More menu) silently returns null with no feedback to the user.
